# Watch all mail logs live
tail -f /var/log/mail.log

# Watch only errors
tail -f /var/log/mail.log | grep -i "error\|fail\|reject"

# Check recent postfix logs
journalctl -u postfix --since "10 minutes ago"

# Check recent dovecot logs
journalctl -u dovecot --since "10 minutes ago"

# Check dovecot auth failures only
journalctl -u dovecot --since "10 minutes ago" | grep -i "fail\|error"

# Check nginx roundcube errors
tail -f /var/log/nginx/roundcube_error.log

# Check roundcube application errors
tail -f /var/log/roundcube/errors.log

# Watch all logs simultaneously
tail -f /var/log/mail.log \
       /var/log/nginx/roundcube_error.log \
       /var/log/roundcube/errors.log
